Source: https://github.com/lius-new/lgui
Revision: fcde9fb7f331baf94f2bb4d76f2b3f42c9f8aef5

Local patch: expose a Windows-only drag_and_drop option in WinitWindowOptions.
The default retains Winit behavior. Applications which own their native file-drop
handler may disable Winit's redundant OLE target before window creation.

The manifest uses the original fixed git dependencies. Original licenses are retained.

renderer.rs also draws into the retained Windows softbuffer DIB, with buffer-age
validation and the required zero high byte. Other platforms keep their presenter.
